interface.longDescription: Mimo provides public power bank station information in ChatGPT. Find active stations near a chosen location, check available power banks and free return slots, and view current rental tariffs using a station number or QR. QR-only lookup may show pricing without confirming live station availability. Connecting Mimo requires the user's approval in ChatGPT. Card setup, deposits and physical power bank dispensing are not available through the guest ChatGPT flow yet.
